apply.title: Become a coach
apply.subtitle: Fill in your profile. An admin will review it, and once it's approved you'll be able to set your available times.
apply.reviewNote: If you change your sport, description or rate later, your profile will be reviewed again.

PENDING.title: Your application is pending
PENDING.description: You'll be notified as soon as an admin reviews it.

APPROVED.title: Your profile is approved
APPROVED.description: If you change your sport, description or rate, your profile will be reviewed again.

REJECTED.title: Your application was rejected
REJECTED.description: Update your profile and send it again.

form.rateHint: An indicative rate shown in the list. You'll set the price of each session in your available times.
form.certificationsPlaceholder: e.g. Tennis coaching diploma, level B

admin.title: Coach approval
admin.subtitle: Review coach profiles before they go public.

PENDING.title: No pending applications
PENDING.description: When someone applies to be a coach, you'll find it here.

APPROVED.title: No approved coaches
APPROVED.description: Coaches you approve will show up here.

REJECTED.title: No rejected applications
REJECTED.description: Applications you reject will show up here.

actions.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The description is too short.
actions.reasonHint: The user will see it. Write it in the language you read the page in, it will be translated automatically.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We couldn't load the applications. Try again in a moment.

page.title: Coaches
page.subtitle: Find a coach for your sport and your area.

empty.title: No coaches found
empty.description: Try changing the area or the sport to see more results.

availability.title: Available times
availability.none: There are no available times right now.
availability.emptyDay: There are no available times on this day.
availability.requestSoon: Sending a request will be available soon.

slots.title: My availability
slots.subtitle: Set when you are available and at what price.

notApproved.title: Your profile is not approved
notApproved.description: You can set your available times once your profile is approved.

list.heading: Times for the day
list.empty: There are no times on this day. Add one below.

form.title: New time
form.errorDate: Pick a date from today onwards.
form.errorOrder: The end must be after the start.
form.errorPast: The start time has already passed.
form.errorPrice: Enter a valid price, e.g. 25 or 37.50.
form.errorOverlap: This time overlaps with an existing one. Pick another time.
form.errorInvalid: This time cannot be added. Check the details and try again.

slots.deleteConflict: This time cannot be deleted because its status has changed.
slots.deleteError: The time was not deleted. Try again.
